The claim 'no part could run past 1938-12-31' is arithmetically false.
Gap 3 repeats the wrong 1938-12-31 outer bound; the bound claimed and disclosed is inconsistent with the order's own 1931 + 10 years term.

rationale: Identity, date and the single command are confirmed from two non-original held texts (transcription ruling: provisional only). By its own terms the order extends trust periods expiring in 1931 by 10 years, so the extended periods ended at dates in 1941, latest 1941-12-31 inclusive. No later instrument citing it is held, and no command survives to 2026-10-14, so 'no' is substantively the right status, ending basis own terms. But the proposal's stated bound (1938-12-31) is wrong and inconsistent with its own premise, and is repeated in the gaps; under the strict standard a proposal with a wrong date/bound is rejected. Kit-route limits (no dossier, no acceptable_as_original, material_gaps non-empty, approved false) also mean it could not pass _decision_errors as is.
